Hello, my name is Yugenshi Jisu, and I am a Vtuber on Youtube, Twitch, and Showroom.
I saw your wonderful illustration in a new article and sent a request to you.

I would like to use this illustration for New Year's Day.
I would like an illustration for New Year's Day.
We plan to use it as a thumbnail for a distribution site, on various social networking services, and as an online print for one week around New Year's in 2024.
We would like to use free materials to add text, messages, and decorations to the work.
We will not use the acqueyes for commercial purposes.

We are not interested in commercial use of ackee, etc.
We will leave the costumes, poses, and composition up to you.
We would like to have separate background images and transparent images of the characters.
If possible, we would like to have some Chinese elements.
If possible, we would like the face and hair to not be visible.

Character Details
Character: A cheerful clunky little Kyu-Kyung-Shi with a flat infantile body. She has a flattened, infantile body.
Image color: Reddish
Hair color: White/silver
Hairstyle: Bob to long (I leave it to you to braid or put hair in a bun. You don't need a chignon.)
Bangs: Patted
Antennae: With princess cut
Skin color: Please use skin color this time.
Eye color: Brown/yellow/gold
Eye shape: Parallel eyes (Jito-eye?)
Other features: Marrow eyebrows (short eyebrows are also acceptable), jagged teeth

Thank you very much for your consideration.
